ats.title: BoondManager (ATS / ERP)
ats.description: Connect your agency's ATS to see missions ending, available consultants and open needs.
ats.writeNotice: {{brand}} reads your ERP. It writes only after a second manager approves (whoever asks cannot approve their own request): nothing leaves on its own.
ats.connectedNoDate: Connected. No successful exchange recorded yet.
ats.needsReconnectHelp: BoondManager refused to renew access. Click “Reconnect” and accept the connection again: until then, {{brand}} reads nothing.
ats.legacyNotice: This connection uses a permanent token, which BoondManager no longer allows for new connections. It still works; connect it with your account to move to OAuth2.
ats.environmentNotice: The connection comes from the server configuration, not from your workspace. Connect your BoondManager so your team reads ITS talent pool.
ats.notAvailable: The BoondManager connection is not yet enabled on this server.

returnError.access_denied: You declined access at BoondManager: nothing was connected.
returnError.generic: The BoondManager connection did not complete. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support.

ats.writeNone: No write access is granted to this connection: {{brand}} only reads. Reconnect BoondManager and accept the write permissions to offer any.
ats.unreachable: BoondManager does not answer with this access: reconnect it.

warnings.appOauthRedirection: BoondManager reports an OAuth application redirect setting to fix.

telephony.title: Calling tool
telephony.description: Aircall, Ringover or Allo: {{brand}} reads your call log and files it into your CRM, so you stop retyping what you just said.
telephony.readOnlyNotice: Read only. {{brand}} never dials a number and never records anything itself.
telephony.transcriptsLabel: Also read transcripts already produced by the tool
telephony.transcriptsWarning: Only enable this if your company has obtained consent from both parties to the call. Unchecked, {{brand}} reads only the date, the duration and the counterpart.
telephony.transcriptsOn: Transcripts already produced by the tool are read.
telephony.transcriptsOff: Transcripts are not read: only the date, the duration and the counterpart come through.
telephony.announcedLabel: Both parties are told the call is being recorded at the start
telephony.announcedWarning: Without this declaration, {{brand}} analyses no call. Ticking it binds your company: recording without consent is prohibited.
telephony.announcedOn: Recording is declared as announced: calls can be analysed.
telephony.announcedOff: No declaration that recording is announced: no call is analysed.

adminDocs.title: Signature and invoicing
adminDocs.description: Connect your e-signature and invoicing tools: {{brand}} tells you what is waiting for a signature and which invoices are unpaid.
adminDocs.readOnlyNotice: {{brand}} never signs and never pays. It reads what is pending, and only sends to signature a request already prepared and reviewed at your provider. No IBAN is retained.
adminDocs.baseUrlHelper: This provider's contract is not public: the address can be changed without a redeploy.

signatures.title: Waiting for signature
signatures.empty: Nothing is waiting for a signature.

readings.failed: I could not look: the read failed.
readings.unavailable: No answer from: {{list}}. That is not “nothing to report”.

odoo.usage: Read customers and quotes; writes go through your validation.

microsoft.usage: Link the need received, the meeting and the follow-up draft.

google.usage: Link messages, documents and preparations to the right record.

notion.usage: Find your account notes and meeting minutes.

slack.usage: Receive the team’s signals in a channel you choose.

teams.usage: The same alerts, in the team’s Teams channel.

googlechat.usage: Post signals in a Google Chat space.

mattermost.usage: For teams that host their own.

beeper.usage: Link your LinkedIn and WhatsApp conversations to the right contact, without reading their content.

webhook.usage: Send a {{brand}} event to an address you choose.

lemlist.usage: Add a contact to a sequence you wrote; {{copilot}} does not send it.

collective_work.usage: Authorized signals, profile search, publication and application feedback. Three distinct uses.

telephony.usage: Link your calls to the contact and note their outcome.

admin_docs.usage: Follow the signature of a contract prepared in {{brand}}.

invoicing.usage: Pass a validated draft and get the proof of the result back. Do not rebuild accounting.

mcp.usage: Connect your AI assistant; it is set up in Assistant access / MCP.

gridCollective.title: Collective.work
gridCollective.body: Three distinct uses, not connected yet: authorized job-posting signals, profile search, publishing needs with application feedback.
gridCollective.contract: The scope of each has to be contracted with the platform before any connection. Until then {{brand}} reads nothing from it and writes nothing to it.
gridCollective.detected: Meanwhile {{copilot}} already recognizes when a posting goes through an intermediary.
